== Original and remastered English issuer text ==
The original allows a payment during the opponent’s turn to grant the first weapons action in battles at Han’s location for the remainder of that turn. The remaster makes the payment a response when the opponent just initiated a battle here and grants the first weapons action for that battle. The Han-title destiny bonus and the 1 Force game-text cancellation remain. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16603#page=1 Players Committee original sheet, p. 1, slip 4].
